title.narrative: Strengthening Intellectual Property Rights in Georgia, Moldova and Ukraine

description.narrative: This programme aims at supporting economic development in Georgia, Moldova and Ukraine by promoting Intellectual Property Rights (IPR); and consequently, creating a favourable environment for innovation, creativeness and free competition, resulting in strengthening SMEs growth, and increasing investment attractiveness. The action seeks to enhance use and effectiveness of IPR, consistent with the Associations Agreements and DCFTAs provisions, and in line with the ambitions of EU accession process.
